objective: Fix verified BUKLOD AdMob request-before-reservation race, zero-height viewport deadlock, cooldown remount suppression, and out-of-order native ad resolution without increasing ad request spam.
productionBaselineEvidence: GitHub main 1113bb52967f7528b6926cd9d39ff08052215692 (PR #463 merged) reconciled. Supabase production yhanxndaqbmuzbdqlblu ad operational aggregates Oct 30–31, 2026 PH: public_wall_entry 450 app-side ad_request, 111 ad_loaded, 45 ad_impression, 150 ad_failed; of failures 114 AdMob no-fill. Database is read-only for this patch; native production OTA ID not verified.
selectionRationale: Fix direct deterministic client bugs while keeping native SDK, AdMob app/unit IDs, remote flags, request throttles and UI placements unchanged. Do not re-request no-fill inventory in tight loops.
alternativeApproaches: Remove cooldown and immediately request again after failure: rejected due to request inflation and AdMob policy risk.
Increase inline ad density: rejected; not related to load/display bug and risks user experience.
Use a new native ad SDK/build: rejected; unnecessary and cannot be sent over OTA.
Gate native mount on reservation and use bounded eligible probe/remount recovery: selected.
preserveBehaviors: First-view ads require actual viewport eligibility
No more than existing wall/reels ad cadence
Ads do not block creation, submission, points, reading, chat or offline access
Remote kill switches, sensitive route filtering and consent checks preserved
Network no-fill retries do not thrash
acceptanceChecks: CI TypeScript and existing performance QA pass
Compact banner can become eligible with a measurable min-height probe
No SDK mount before slot reservation
Deferred cooldown does not permanently poison ad slot
No-fill stops fast retries; focus/app-resume can recover after cooldown
Native ad timeout late callback destroys ad instead of overwriting fallback
Immutable verified RC required before production OTA, production not claimed without ID
